title: Stir-Fried Savoy Cabbage
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired stir-fry made with crispy savoy cabbage and savory seasonings.
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the savoy cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the juicy stir-fry sauce, sesame oil, and soy sauce. Stir-fry until the cabbage is tender and well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
Optional: Add protein like tofu or tempeh for added nutrition.
